Your offer, explained

A clear next step.
For your gym.

Who is this offer for?

The free app offer is available to all Independent Gyms delegates when they sign up for a GALAXY plan.

What do I receive?

You receive a free app worth £2,399 when you sign up for a GALAXY plan. The team will confirm your app’s scope, setup and delivery details with you.

Is the GALAXY subscription also free?

No. This offer covers the app purchase value of £2,399. GALAXY is a paid subscription; the team will confirm your selected plan’s price and terms.

Are there any ongoing app charges?

Ask the team to confirm any ongoing app costs alongside your GALAXY subscription before signing up. The £2,399 free app offer does not state that all ongoing charges are waived.

How do I claim the offer?

Select “Claim my delegate offer” to open an email to sales@fibodo.com. Tell the team you are an Independent Gyms delegate, and they will help you confirm your plan and offer details.

Can you help me switch platforms?

Yes. GALAXY’s approach includes understanding your venue, configuring the platform, preparing your data and supporting your team through launch.
